recognize_zh: 成群的中大型芽細胞，核圓、染色質細緻、細胞質少至中等，部分芽細胞核中有淡染的凹陷區（杯狀核，cup-shaped nuclei），旁邊有一顆分葉核中性球作對照，是 NPM1 突變 AML 的形態線索。
features: Clusters of medium to large blasts with high N:C ratio
Round nuclei with fine, dispersed chromatin; nucleoli not prominent
Some blasts show a pale nuclear invagination (cup-like indentation)
Scant to moderate agranular pale blue-gray cytoplasm; no Auer rods seen
A single segmented neutrophil and a disrupted larger cell nearby; red cells in background
describe_en: The smear shows clusters of medium to large blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, round nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin and scant to moderate agranular cytoplasm. Several blasts show a pale nuclear invagination giving a cup-shaped (fish-mouth) appearance, although the feature is less conspicuous in this field than in classic examples. Auer rods are not identified, and a single mature segmented neutrophil is present for comparison. In the clinical setting of marked leukocytosis with 85-88% blasts, findings are suggestive of AML with cup-like blast morphology, confirmed as AML with mutated NPM1 and FLT3-ITD.

ddx.vs: Microgranular APL shows bilobed butterfly-shaped nuclei, faint granules and occasional Auer rod bundles, and is confirmed by PML::RARA.
Monoblasts/promonocytes have folded or convoluted nuclei with more abundant gray-blue vacuolated cytoplasm and nonspecific esterase positivity.
Lymphoblasts may show nuclear clefts but are MPO-negative and express B- or T-lymphoid markers on flow cytometry.
